title: 第2章  爷爷的退伍大礼包
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
六年前，两个十八岁的小伙子一起进的新兵连，一起在泥水里爬战术、一起被老班长骂得狗血淋头、一起蹲在厕所里偷偷抽第一根烟。
那时候谁也不认识谁，只知道这个叫林毅的战友体能好得离谱，脑子也灵光，学什么都快，新兵连考核的时候所有科目全优，新兵班长拍着他的肩膀说这小子以后肯定有大出息。
两年后，赵明辉提干，考学，一步步走到了连长的位置。
而林毅戴上了大红花，填好了申请表，排着队上了大巴车。
大巴车发动，缓缓驶出营区大门。
赵明辉站在送行的人群里，看着那辆车拐上国道，越开越远，心里还有点伤感，想着这一别怕是一辈子都见不着了。
然后当天晚上，他就又见到了满脸郁闷，重新入伍的林毅。
一问才知道，大巴车刚走半小时，老连长亲自开车去追，强行逼停了大巴后，把林毅给拽了回来。
据说林毅前脚刚走，一个电话就打到了团部，直接将林毅重新特招入伍。
林毅后来跟赵明辉喝酒的时候说起这个事，沉默许久才说：“是我爷爷打的电话。”
赵明辉差点把嘴里的酒喷出来。
就这样，林毅又当了两年兵。
两年前，又是退伍日。
林毅再次戴上了大红花，退伍申请交上去，一切顺利，公章盖得飞快。
他说他爷爷已经退休了，绝对不可能阻挠他退伍！
这一次，他觉得林毅真的要走了，这一别就真的见不到了。
然后……
当天晚上，林毅拿了瓶茅台出现在他宿舍里。
据林毅讲述，他提着大包小包下了大巴车，回到街道后才得知，他的户籍没迁回去，还在部队。
接着，他就接到了他爸的电话。

人家产房来喜讯，他爸升了！
于是，又是两年的义务兵……
“行了，多余的话我也就不说了，过了今晚，明天一上大巴，你就彻底自由了。”
“出去以后好好过日子，别在折腾了。”
赵明辉叹了口气，感慨道。
“明天过后，哥们儿就自由了！你个还在牢笼里的小家雀儿，还操心起我这个遨游展翅的大鹏了？”林毅打趣一声。
赵明辉朝着他的胳膊就是一拳：“滚蛋！滚得越远越好！”
第二天。
叠好豆腐块，收拾行囊，再次戴上大红花。
很快，大巴车驶入营区内。
林毅把行李塞进行李舱，踏上了车门的踏板，回头看了一眼待了六年的部队。
赵明辉、刘畅、以及那些格外熟悉的面孔，都站在营区内，朝着他挥了挥手。
林毅咧嘴笑了，抬手敬了个标准的军礼。
这一定是这辈子，敬的最后一次军礼了。
他迅速钻进了车厢，找到了靠窗的位置坐下。
车门关闭，大巴缓缓启动。
林毅靠在椅背上，看着窗外的营区建筑一点点后退，那些熟悉的楼房、操场、障碍场、靶场，像放电影一样从眼前滑过。
六年了，他终于，终于能离开军区了！
外面的花花世界，不受约束的生活，还有灯红酒绿，老子，真的要来了！
就是在这个时候。

一道声音在他脑海中毫无预兆地炸响了。
【叮！】
【系统已成功绑定。】
【检测到宿主并不是军人身份，请宿主即刻提交入伍申请表，即可正式激活系统！】
老子刚成功退伍，就又要让老子入伍？
搞咩啊！
林家的书房，陈设简洁，却处处透着威严。
墙上挂着老爷子林建军的少将肩章相框，旁边是他年轻时在边境执勤的黑白照片，棱角分明的脸上满是悍勇之色。
书桌后，林建军穿着一身熨帖的便装，眉头微蹙，眼神里满是无奈。
书桌对面，林国栋坐得笔直，上校军衔的常服外套搭在椅背上，手里端着浓茶，深深的叹了口气：“爸，算了，别琢磨了。”
“林毅这小子，这次是铁了心要退伍，前两次拦着他，闹得鸡飞狗跳，营区上下都知道咱们林家出了个‘反复横跳’的义务兵，这次要是在拦着，搞不好就要把天给捅破了！”
林建军沉默了片刻，眼神中尽是不甘：“我不是想拦他，这小子是块好苗子，他从小体能就拔尖，身体素质也被咱们打磨的很好，就这么退伍，太可惜了。”
“而且，咱们俩在部队里打拼了一辈子，就到了他这断代了？你嘴上说的轻巧，你甘心看着他回来？”
在部队里待了一辈子，他早就根深蒂固的认为，生是部队人，死是部队魂了！
自己儿子也就那样，身体素质，体能方面都只能算是及格，跟年轻时的自己差远了。
但好在自己留下的老底在，能拉儿子一把，让他到了现在的位置。
而自己孙子林毅呢。
打小他就喜欢这孩子，也正如他所说的那样，这孩子无论是体能，身体素质，还有各方面的条件，那是一顶一的出众，比年轻时的自己都要强上一些！
简直就是天生的当兵苗子！
既然当爹的指望不上，那就只能把希望寄托在孙子身上了！

而孙子林毅，确实在部队闯出了名堂，三次入伍，三次退伍，这名堂当真是大啊！
那些老战友们听到了这个消息后，笑的差点直接过去了。
他娘的。
“可惜有什么用？”林国栋苦笑一声，喝了口茶，“他从小就野，您越管，他越叛逆。”
“第一次您扣他退伍申请表，他直接在营区里摆烂，要么故意迟到早退，要么跟纠察对着干，您还不是没辙？”
“这第二次又让我扣下了，到了部队他还是那么个尿性，我也拿他没招。”
“现在啊，我看是没必要再跟他较这个劲，退就退吧。”
他这个当爹的，在管教儿子方面是真没办法。
林毅的性格他太清楚了，简直跟自己的亲爹一个模子刻出来的，那倔脾气上来了，别说九头牛了，九十头牛都拉不回来。
这爷孙三代，也就他脾气挺好，也不知道随了谁了。
但这话他可不敢当着老爹的面说。
林建军叹了口气：“罢了罢了，儿孙自有儿孙福。”
说罢，他瞪了眼林国栋。
那意思好似再说：你小子要是能让老子我省心，我还至于指望孙子？哼！
林建军扭头看了眼桌子上的座钟，“算算时间，送兵的大巴车快到大院了吧？”
林国栋抬起腕表，出声附和：“大巴出发一个多小时了，路程不远，估计午饭前就能到家。”
“那就好。”林建军撑着扶手椅慢慢站起来，腰板挺得笔直，嘴角藏着一抹智珠在握的淡淡笑容，“我都安排好了，等他左脚一进门，就给我把他看住了，千万别让这小子跑了！”
林国栋眼睛一亮，顺着话头接茬：“您老这是终于舍得动手打孙子了？”
“废什么话，自己儿子你这个当老子的自己教训去。”林建军满脸看不上儿子的不耐道，“我这个当爷爷的，给他备了份大礼。”
林国栋忍不住好奇问道：“……什么东西啊？”

话说，老爹这是被气糊涂了吗？
就林毅这小子几次三番执意退伍，还给他准备礼物？
不过略一咂摸，老爷子这话里的滋味似乎有点不对劲儿。
这礼物它……正经吗？
content_en:
Six years ago, two 18-year-old boys joined the recruit company together. They crawled in mud and water to practice tactics together, were scolded bloody by the old squad leader, and squatted in the toilet together to secretly smoke their first cigarette.
At that time, no one knew anyone. They only knew that this comrade named Lin Yi had extremely good physical fitness, a bright mind, and could learn everything quickly. During the recruit company's assessment, he got excellent marks in all subjects. The recruit squad leader patted him on the shoulder and said that this kid would definitely have a great future.
Two years later, Zhao Minghui passed the examination and gradually reached the position of company commander.
Lin Yi put on a big red flower, filled out the application form, and lined up to get on the bus.
The bus started and slowly drove out of the camp gate.
Zhao Minghui stood in the crowd of people seeing him off, watching the car turn onto the national highway and drive further and further away. He felt a little sad, thinking that he might never see this again for the rest of his life.
Then that night, he saw Ji Yi, who was depressed and re-enlisted in the army.
After asking, I found out that just half an hour after the bus left, the old company commander personally drove to chase him. After forcing the bus to stop, he dragged Ji Yi back.
It is said that as soon as Lin Yi left, a phone call was made to the regiment headquarters, and Lin Yi was directly recruited into the army.
Lin Yi later talked about this matter when he was drinking with Zhao Minghui. He was silent for a long time before saying, "It was my grandpa who made the call."
Zhao Minghui almost spit out the wine in his mouth.
In this way, Lin Yi served as a soldier for another two years.
Two years ago, it was Veterans Day again.
Ji Yi put on the big red flower again and handed in the discharge application. Everything went smoothly and the official seal was stamped quickly.
He said that his grandfather had already retired and there was absolutely no way he could stop him from retiring from the army!
This time, he felt that Ji Yi was really leaving, and he would never see her again after this farewell.
Then...
That night, Lin Yi showed up in his dormitory with a bottle of Moutai.
According to Lin Yi's account, he got off the bus with large and small bags, and only after returning to the street did he learn that his household registration had not been moved back, and he was still in the army.
Then, he received a call from his dad.
Good news came to the delivery room, his father was promoted!
So, another two years of compulsory military service...
"Okay, I won't say any more. After tonight, as soon as you get on the bus tomorrow, you will be completely free."
"Live a good life after you go out, don't worry about it anymore."
Zhao Minghui sighed and said with emotion.
"After tomorrow, buddy, you will be free! You are still a little bird in a cage, but you still worry about me, a flying roc?" Lin Yi joked.
Zhao Minghui punched his arm: "Get out! Get away as far away as possible!"
The next day.
Fold the tofu cubes, pack your bags, and wear the big red flower again.
Soon, the bus drove into the camp area.
Ji Yi stuffed his luggage into the luggage compartment, stepped on the door step, and looked back at the army where he had been for six years.
Zhao Minghui, Liu Chang, and those very familiar faces all stood in the camp and waved to him.
Ji Yi grinned and raised his hand to give a standard military salute.
This must be the last military salute in this life.
He quickly got into the car and found a seat by the window to sit down.
The door closed and the bus started slowly.
Ji Yi leaned on the back of his chair and watched the camp buildings outside the window recede little by little. Those familiar buildings, playgrounds, obstacle courses, and shooting ranges slid past his eyes like a movie.
After six years, he was finally able to leave the military zone!
The colorful world outside, the unfettered life, and the feasting, I am really coming!
That's when.
A voice exploded in his mind without warning.
【bite! 】
[The system has been successfully bound. 】
[It is detected that the host is not a military member. Please submit the enlistment application form immediately to officially activate the system! 】
I just successfully retired from the army, you want me to enlist in the army again?
What the hell!
The Lin family's study room is simply furnished, yet full of majesty.
There is a master hanging on the wallZi Lin Jianjun's major general epaulette photo frame is next to a black and white photo of him on duty at the border when he was young. His angular face is full of bravery.
Behind the desk, Lin Jianjun was wearing pressed casual clothes, his brows were slightly furrowed, and his eyes were full of helplessness.
Opposite the desk, Lin Guodong sat upright, his uniform coat with the rank of colonel draped on the back of the chair, holding strong tea in his hand, and sighed deeply: "Dad, forget it, don't think about it."
"Jin Yi, this kid, is determined to retire this time. He stopped him twice before, which caused a lot of trouble. Everyone in the camp knows that our Lin family has a conscript who 'jumps repeatedly'. If he stops him this time, he might break the sky!"
Lin Jianjun was silent for a moment, with a look of reluctance in his eyes: "I don't want to stop him. This kid is a good prospect. His physical fitness has been top-notch since he was a child, and his physical fitness has been polished very well by us. It's a shame to retire like this."
"Moreover, we have worked hard in the army all our lives, and now it's time for him to die? What you say is so easy, are you willing to watch him come back?"
Having been in the army all his life, he has long been ingrained in the belief that he is a member of the army when he is born, and his soul is the soul of the army when he dies!
My son is just like that. In terms of physical fitness and physical fitness, he can only be regarded as passing. He is far from his younger self.
But fortunately, he left behind a legacy and was able to help his son get to where he is now.
And what about his grandson Lin Yi?
He has liked this child since he was a child, and as he said, this child is outstanding in terms of physical strength, physical fitness, and all aspects of conditions, and is better than himself when he was young!
He is simply born to be a soldier!
Since you can't expect to be a father, you can only place your hopes on your grandson!
And grandson Lin Yi has indeed made a name for himself in the army. He enlisted in the army three times and was discharged three times. What a big name he has!
When the old comrades heard the news, they almost passed away with laughter.
Damn it.
"What's the use of being a pity?" Lin Guodong smiled bitterly and took a sip of tea, "He has been wild since he was a child. The more you control him, the more rebellious he becomes."
"The first time you withheld his discharge application form, he left it lying around in the camp. He either deliberately arrived late or left early, or went against the pickets. Isn't there nothing you can do?"
"I detained him again this second time. When he got to the army, he was still such a jerk, and I couldn't do anything to him."
"Now, I think there is no need to compete with him anymore, so just retreat."
As a father, he really has no choice in disciplining his son.
He knew Ji Yi's character very well. He was modeled after his biological father. When his stubborn temper got worse, not to mention nine or ninety cows, he couldn't get it back.
Among the three generations of grandfather and grandson, he was the only one with a good temper, and he didn't know who he followed.
But he didn't dare to say this in front of his father.
Lin Jianjun sighed: "That's all, children and grandchildren will have their own blessings."
After saying that, he glared at Lin Guodong.
It's like saying: If you can make me worry less, why should I expect my grandson? snort!
Lin Jianjun turned his head and glanced at the clock on the table, "Counting the time, the bus transporting soldiers will arrive at the compound soon, right?"
Lin Guodong raised his watch and echoed: "The bus has been leaving for more than an hour. It's not a long journey. I think I'll be home before lunch."
"That's good." Lin Jianjun stood up slowly, holding on to the armchair, with his back straight and a faint smile hidden at the corner of his mouth. "I have made arrangements. As soon as he walks in with his left foot, I will keep an eye on him. Don't let this kid run away!"
Lin Guodong's eyes lit up and he continued: "Is your boss finally willing to beat his grandson?"
"What nonsense are you talking about? You, the father, teach your own son a lesson." Lin Jianjun said impatiently, looking down on his son. "I, the grandfather, have prepared a big gift for him."
Lin GuodongI couldn't help but asked curiously: "...what is it?"
By the way, is Dad confused?
Just how many times has Ji Ji insisted on retiring from the army, and why do you still prepare gifts for him?
But after a quick glance, there seemed to be something wrong with the old man's words.
Is this gift... serious?
